patch.value: Converge changelog generation and verification on replace mode

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Converging changelog generation/verification on replace mode. Deleted the changelog:check fallback (`|| (regenerate && git diff --exit-code)`) which regenerated in PREPEND mode (would corrupt a replace-mode CHANGELOG) and mutated the working tree on a check. changelog:check now runs `npm run changelog:full -- --check`. release.yml CHANGELOG.md generate+check lines switched to --mode replace --all-release-tags; release notes --stdout line left windowed. changelog:full already used replace mode.

patch.value: Switched changelog:check to npm run changelog:full -- --check (removing the || regenerate && git diff fallback) and changed release.yml CHANGELOG.md generate+check lines to --mode replace --all-release-tags.
npm run changelog:check passes against a replace-mode CHANGELOG.md without mutating the working tree; generation and verification use the same mode.
build, check, 127 tests pass; changelog:full regenerates idempotently; changelog:check passes.
Converged changelog generation and verification on replace mode; deleted the prepend-mode regen-and-diff fallback from changelog:check.
